title: nyblnet/bento
claim: nyblnet/bento — Bento, the office suite that fits in a file
why_good: A whole office suite (view/edit/data/collab) packed into a single HTML file — a radically portable, no-install take on documents.
value: Freemium: free single-file suite, paid collaboration/hosting/enterprise; portability is a genuine wedge vs cloud suites.
risk: Google/Microsoft own docs; 'in one file' is neat but must win real workflows, not just novelty.

zh.claim: nyblnet/bento —— 装进一个文件里的办公套件。
zh.why_good: 把整套办公套件(查看/编辑/数据/协作)塞进一个 HTML 文件——一种极致可移植、免安装的文档做法。
zh.value: 免费增值:单文件套件免费,协作/托管/企业收费;可移植性相对云套件是真实切口。
zh.risk: Google/微软掌控文档;装进一个文件 很妙,但要赢真实工作流,不能只靠新奇。
zh.gap: 说出口就站不住：「整个办公套件装在一个文件里」讲的是可移植性，而挡住普通人把一份文档做完的从来不是可移植性。
zh.counter: 这正是终端用户闸门要拦的那个形状——「某 SaaS 的开源替代」。工作流握在 Google 和微软手里，而卖点是一条工程属性，不是一个人的问题。作为能力信号归档。

gap: No gap that survives being said out loud: 'the office suite in one file' is portability, and portability is not what stops an ordinary person from getting a document done.
counter: This is the 'open-source alternative to <SaaS>' shape the end-user gate exists to catch — Google and Microsoft own the workflow, and the pitch is an engineering property rather than a person's problem. Archived as a capability signal.
consumer_angle: None that can be named without saying 'a developer'. Fails the end-user gate (STANDARD 1a); kept as archive evidence, not front page.
